review_method: Deterministic set review over six accepted_locked, exact-Git-read-back, saved-Git-reviewed production PNGs.

set_review.basis: Six distinct sealed subjects/mechanisms and production paths; every saved Git asset independently passed structural/editorial/text/factual/no-people gates and now has story-specific alt text.

images.subject: Cohere Embed 5 retrieval architecture
images.mechanism: Show text and image inputs entering two differentiated Pro/Fast embedding paths that converge into one shared vector space; depict a long-context intake ribbon, multilingual streams, Matryoshka nested vector dimensions, and downstream retrieval neighborhoods without inventing benchmark scores.

accessibility.alt_text: Textbook mechanism diagram for Cohere Embed 5 retrieval architecture: text and image inputs entering two differentiated Pro/Fast embedding paths that converge into one shared vector space; depict a long-context intake ribbon, multilingual streams, Matryoshka nested vector dimensions, and downstream retrieval neighborhoods without inventing benchmark scores.

images.subject: Dogwood temporal governance for agent actions
images.mechanism: Show an agent action sequence moving through a temporal policy engine before tools execute; include ordered action history, stateful policy checks, allowed/denied transitions, and an execution trace that makes the sequence constraint visually explicit.

accessibility.alt_text: Textbook mechanism diagram for Dogwood temporal governance for agent actions: an agent action sequence moving through a temporal policy engine before tools execute; include ordered action history, stateful policy checks, allowed/denied transitions, and an execution trace that makes the sequence constraint visually explicit.

images.subject: Trusted enterprise context for people and agents
images.mechanism: Show fragmented enterprise knowledge flowing through provenance, recency, corroboration and human-validation layers into a trusted context graph; show an agent deciding whether to use knowledge or route it for expert validation, with an auditable source trail.

accessibility.alt_text: Textbook mechanism diagram for Trusted enterprise context for people and agents: fragmented enterprise knowledge flowing through provenance, recency, corroboration and human-validation layers into a trusted context graph; show an agent deciding whether to use knowledge or route it for expert validation, with an auditable source trail.

images.subject: Slack MCP Server operations on Lists and records
images.mechanism: Show an AI workflow calling a governed MCP layer that performs create/read/update/delete operations against structured Lists and records; include CRM/admin workflow branches and a return path showing reduced context switching, without mimicking Slack UI.

accessibility.alt_text: Textbook mechanism diagram for Slack MCP Server operations on Lists and records: an AI workflow calling a governed MCP layer that performs create/read/update/delete operations against structured Lists and records; include CRM/admin workflow branches and a return path showing reduced context switching, without mimicking Slack UI.

images.subject: Reusable Gemini Skills
images.mechanism: Show a maintained reusable Skill package containing saved instructions and reference files, invoked by matching prompts and composable with other Skills; depict repeated work lanes all reusing the same maintained package to explain why the mechanism reduces repetitive prompting.

accessibility.alt_text: Textbook mechanism diagram for Reusable Gemini Skills: a maintained reusable Skill package containing saved instructions and reference files, invoked by matching prompts and composable with other Skills; depict repeated work lanes all reusing the same maintained package to explain why the mechanism reduces repetitive prompting.

images.subject: Muse for Small Business with approval boundaries
images.mechanism: Show a small-business agent hub connected to distinct business systems for marketing, commerce, finance, collaboration and files; requests pass through explicit approval boundaries before actions; show skills/connectors as reusable capability modules, not a dashboard.
